text: Five ways to make people stay past the first three seconds.
Show the result first, like, this took me thirty days, and they stay to see how.
Start in the middle of the action. No intro. Movement beats hey guys.
Call out a mistake, like, stop doing this, and they stay to check if it's them.
Ask a question they can't answer yet, and they stay for the answer.
Put the payoff on screen, like, three tools, the last one's free, and they wait for the last one.
Not sure which one your reel is missing? Comment GROW, and I'll send you Cree-dum. It checks before you post.
